command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP: systemd unit for loop persistence =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/lvm-loop-setup.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed PVs for datavg before local filesystems mount
DefaultDependencies=no
Before=local-fs-pre.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target
After=systemd-udevd.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/lvm-loop-setup.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
EOF
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable lvm-loop-setup.service

echo "== STEP: create backing disk images =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/lvm-loop
sudo -n truncate -s 1200M /var/lib/lvm-loop/disk1.img
sudo -n truncate -s 1200M /var/lib/lvm-loop/disk2.img
ls -la /var/lib/lvm-loop/

echo "== STEP: attach loop devices =="
sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/lvm-loop-setup.sh
losetup -a | grep lvm-loop

LOOP1=$(sudo -n losetup -j /var/lib/lvm-loop/disk1.img | cut -d: -f1)
LOOP2=$(sudo -n losetup -j /var/lib/lvm-loop/disk2.img | cut -d: -f1)
echo "LOOP1=$LOOP1 LOOP2=$LOOP2"

echo "== STEP: create PV, VG, LV (initial < 2G) =="
sudo -n pvcreate -y "$LOOP1"
sudo -n vgcreate datavg "$LOOP1"
sudo -n lvcreate -L 1000M -n datalv datavg
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -q /dev/datavg/datalv

echo "== STEP: mount at /srv/data =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
sudo -n mount /dev/datavg/datalv /srv/data
grep -q '^/dev/datavg/datalv' /etc/fstab || \
  echo '/dev/datavg/datalv /srv/data xfs defaults 0 0' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab

echo "== STEP: write test content =="
sudo -n sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 50); do dd if=/dev/urandom of=/srv/data/testfile_$i.bin bs=1M count=1 2>/dev/null; done'
sudo -n sh -c 'cd /srv/data && sha256sum testfile_*.bin > /srv/data/CHECKSUMS.sha256'
sudo -n sha256sum -c /srv/data/CHECKSUMS.sha256 --quiet && echo "checksums OK pre-grow"

echo "== STEP: baseline df/lvs before grow =="
